title: Taiwanese American Association of Mississippi 密西西比臺灣同鄉會
content_html: The Taiwanese American Association of Mississippi (密西西比臺灣同鄉會) is a chapter of the Taiwanese Association of America (TAA, 全美台灣同鄉會), the national umbrella organization serving Taiwanese American communities across the United States. The chapter serves the Taiwanese American community in Mississippi and is listed in the TAA national chapter directory.
